Title: Homepage displays product catalog
Steps: 1. Open https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/. 2. Wait for page load. 3. Verify search box and product listings visible.
Expected Result: Homepage loads. Product catalog visible. Search and sort controls present. No error page.

Title: Customer login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Go to https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/auth/login. 2. Enter customer@practicesoftwaretesting.com / welcome01. 3. Click login.
Expected Result: User redirected to account area. Nav menu shows logged-in state. No error message.

Title: Product detail page shows name and price
Steps: 1. Open https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/product/01KZ2WFC8DM9KV0TCKB1MFSDRB. 2. Verify product name and unit price visible.
Expected Result: Product name and price displayed. Add to cart control visible.

Title: Add product to cart updates cart quantity
Steps: 1. Login as customer. 2. Open sample product. 3. Increase quantity to 2. 4. Click Add to cart. 5. Check nav cart badge.
Expected Result: Cart quantity updates (greater than 0). No crash.

Title: Checkout COD generates invoice (double Confirm)
Preconditions: User logged in with item in cart
Steps: 1. Add product to cart. 2. Go to checkout. 3. Complete billing (country TG, postal 1234AA, street Zoey Shore, city Hesselbury, state Florida). 4. Select Cash on Delivery. 5. Click finish then Confirm twice if prompted.
Expected Result: Success message with invoice number INV-*. Order completes without error.
Notes: Assessment requires double Confirm for invoice

Title: My Invoices lists generated invoices
Preconditions: User logged in with prior orders
Steps: 1. Login. 2. Navigate to Account > My Invoices. 3. Verify invoice table.
Expected Result: Invoice list visible with INV- numbers and totals. Page loads without error.

Title: Login with invalid credentials rejected
Steps: 1. Go to login page. 2. Enter invalid@example.com / wrongpass. 3. Submit.
Expected Result: Error message shown. User stays on login. No account access.

Title: API login returns bearer token
Steps: 1. POST https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com/users/login with customer credentials. 2. Inspect response.
Expected Result: HTTP 200. Body contains access_token and token_type bearer.
